reasoning_content: Wait, `down` without `-v` doesn't delete named volumes. The keycloak-database volume (kcdata) might still have partial state in it. In fact, the previous import failed midway — could it have committed partial data to the DB? The import failed at createUser; does KC roll back? To be safe, let's delete the kcdata volume and start over from scratch. Also, check the frontend serve logs.

action.command:
cd /workspace && docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml stop keycloak 2>&1 | tail -1
docker volume rm startuphafen-devcontainer_kcdata 2>&1
docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml up -d keycloak 2>&1 | tail -1
tail -5 /tmp/frontend_serve.log
